th.style: background:#f1f3f5; border-bottom:1.5px solid #333333; padding:10px 14px; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; color:#111827; text-align:left;

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

td.b: UC-02: Run Capability Analysis and Generate Nutrition Label

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;
width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td: 1. Extracted source bundle exists in version storage with status analysing.

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
1. System parses Python source files into an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST).
2. Static Semgrep rules scan for filesystem writes, network calls, subprocesses, and secrets.
3. Engine infers entry point, runtime dependencies, framework, and target listening port.
4. System aggregates findings and synthesizes a human-readable Capability Nutrition Label.
5. Nutrition label is attached to version record and status advances to awaiting approval.

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
Success: Capability manifest and build plan generated; version queued for approval.
Failure: Version marked failed with structured error logs; deployment aborted.

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
1a. Syntax parse error: File flagged unanalysable; label marked incomplete with warning.
3a. Ambiguous entry point: Diagnostics listing candidate files generated; status set to failed.
